responses:
**Recommendation: don't send.** Three of the analysis's four findings contradict the tender. The P-01 motor as offered doesn't comply, and several requirements are missing from the analysis entirely.

## Finding-by-finding review

| # | Finding (agent) | Source (tender.md) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Motors must be IE3; IE3 offered on all motors including 90 kW P-01 | §4.2 "IE3 efficiency class minimum"; **§9.1** "Notwithstanding clause 4.2, pump motors rated above 75 kW shall be IE4"; **§9.3** Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7 | P-01 (90 kW): **IE4 required**. P-02 (37 kW): IE3 minimum | Yes. §9.1 overrides §4.2 for any motor above 75 kW | **CONTRADICTED**: P-01 needs IE4; IE3 is OK for P-02 only |
| 2 | ATEX not required | §4.3 "Motors installed in hazardous areas classified Zone 1 (see Annex B) shall be ATEX Ex d certified"; Annex B: Wet well = Zone 1; schedule: P-01 is in the wet well | P-01: **APPLIES** (Ex d). P-02 (valve chamber, non-hazardous): DOES NOT APPLY | Section 9 has no ATEX exception | **CONTRADICTED**: P-01 motor must be ATEX Ex d |
| 3 | Supply 400 V / 60 Hz | §4.1 "400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply" | APPLIES to all equipment | No override in Section 9 | **CONTRADICTED**: it's 50 Hz, not 60 Hz. A motor rated for 60 Hz only won't run at its rated speed on 50 Hz. |
| 4 | IP65 required; IP66 offered, complies | §4.5 "Panel and motor terminal enclosures shall be IP65 or better" | APPLIES to panels and motor terminal boxes | No override | **VERIFIED** for the requirement. IP66 meets "IP65 or better". The IP66 figure comes from our offer, which isn't in the repo, so check it against the datasheet. |

## Requirements the analysis left out

- **§4.4:** Power cables need at least 2.5 mm² conductor cross-section. Cabling is in scope.
- **§7.1:** Warranty is 24 months from commissioning, not from delivery.
- **§7.4:** Delivery within 16 weeks of the purchase order. **Any offer over 16 weeks is rejected.** An IE4 + Ex d 90 kW motor may have a long lead time, so confirm it before quoting.
- **§9.2:** The design ambient temperature is 50 °C. Standard motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so the P-01 and P-02 motors and the panels need to be rated or derated for 50 °C.
- **§4.1** also says 3-phase, which the analysis didn't mention.
- **Clause numbering:** Section 7 goes from 7.1 straight to 7.4. Either 7.2 and 7.3 are missing from our copy or they were deliberately left out. Ask the customer to confirm. **NEEDS HUMAN**

## Summary

- **Counts:** 1 VERIFIED, 3 CONTRADICTED, 0 UNSUPPORTED, 1 NEEDS HUMAN (the missing 7.2/7.3)
- **Root cause:** The analysis read only Section 4. It skipped the Section 9 special conditions and how they rank against Section 4, and it never matched the equipment schedule to Annex B.
- **What P-01 actually needs:** a 90 kW, IE4, ATEX Ex d motor for 400 V / 3-phase / 50 Hz, rated for 50 °C ambient, with IP65 or better terminal box, delivered within 16 weeks.

**NO-GO:** Before sending, fix P-01 to IE4 + Ex d, correct the supply to 50 Hz, and add the missing requirements: cable size, warranty, delivery limit and 50 °C ambient.
